title: Class improvement
description:
An optional rule from the expanded content that changes what a class is worth to a character who is not simply advancing in it. There are three, and every class has one of each: a class improvement rewards staying, a multiclass improvement says what the class contributes to a character who has levels elsewhere, and a splashclass improvement is the single benefit a character can take from a class they have no levels in at all.

The three are one content type rather than three because they are the same document in every respect a reader or a store cares about — a class, a prerequisite and a paragraph of rules — and because they are used together: the question at the table is "what does berserker give me if I multiclass", which wants all three side by side, not three near-empty catalogues of ten items each. The kind is a field, so it filters.

key.description: Stable slug identifying this improvement, built from the class and the kind: berserker-multiclass-improvement. The class name alone is not unique here, because each class has three of these.

name.description: Display name, built the same way the key is: "Berserker Multiclass Improvement". The archive stores only the class name, which is ambiguous on its own once all three kinds sit in one list.

className.description: Name of the class this improvement belongs to, matching a class entry.

improvementType.description: Which of the three kinds this is. `class` is taken by a character advancing in the class; `multiclass` describes what the class contributes to a character with levels in another; `splashclass` is available to a character with no levels in the class at all.

prerequisite.description: What a character must already have to take this, in the books' own words: "At least 3 levels in berserker", "No levels in consular, the ability to cast force powers". Left as prose because the clauses are not a closed set — a level count, an absence of levels, and a capability all appear, sometimes together.

description.description: Markdown rules text in second person, describing what the improvement grants.

sourceKey.description: Key of the source this improvement was published in, matching a document of the source content type. All thirty are ec.

contentSet.description: Whether this improvement belongs to the core rules or to the community expanded-content supplement. All thirty are expanded content: none of this is in the Player's Handbook.
